title: fix(composer): move model pill back to usage strip above composer
context:
a9570395 (CCC-823) moved the model pill from the #convInputContext strip
into the composer's action-button row. CCC-908 (filed ~21h later, same
author) asked for the opposite: pill back in that strip, action row keeps
just Esc/TTS/mic/send. Revert the placement only — the "label shows just
the model name, not reasoning effort" simplification from the same commit
stays as-is, since that wasn't part of the complaint.
